notes.title: SLINGER Free Update v0.2
notes.notes:
In this update there are lots of new changes:

- Dynamic weather
- Better art assets 
- fixed animation sync over network
- fixed UI calls
- Outline stoke of player objects and the game world to increase visibility

AND A LOT MORE!!!

If you like the game consider donating on CashApp, THANKS and enjoy :)

notes.title: SLINGER v1.0 Release!
notes.notes:
[b]SLINGER[/b] is live on the store page! 

Enjoy the fun and have a good time playing the multiplayer in the full game. The demo will still be available on the store page as well. The multiplayer servers are up and running for you and your friends to play!

Happy slinging.
